name: Volt Industrial Plastics Inc
old_description: Founded by Joe Voltrauer, Volt Industrial Plastics has a history of rising above and providing quality parts with passion. From Germany to Arkansas, the Volltrauer story is an impressive one, and one that molds the very parts being produced to this day. Watch the video below to learn more about Volt's history.
about:
Volt Industrial Plastics operates from Yellville, Arkansas. Founded by Joe Voltrauer, the company has been providing custom plastic fastener solutions for over three decades, tracing its roots from Germany to its current Arkansas facility.

The company manufactures a broad line of plastic fasteners under one roof, including bushings, washers, threaded rod, standoffs, rivets, pins, spacers, screws, nuts, clips, circuit board hardware, caps, plugs, and cable routing components. Its production model emphasizes American-made products shipped worldwide without hidden fees.

Volt serves national and global markets, with its circuit board hardware line addressing electronics applications. The company's customer base spans industrial and commercial buyers seeking competitively priced, domestically produced fasteners.

Volt differentiates itself through a passion-driven engineering approach, a commitment to customer care staffed by knowledgeable representatives, and a single-facility operation that enables fast turnaround and cost savings on plastic fasteners.
